issues.desc: background.md references "the paper" and "the paper repo (Proofbound-AI/paper)" and "section 6" of the paper without naming or describing the paper itself. A new reader has no way to identify what paper this is, making the "paper repo" pointer and section reference unverifiable context.
Conversational Texture mentions "a separate quorum_submit fix" without a story ID or any further context, leaving a new reader unable to identify or locate that parallel work.
